types.name: chain.withdraw.v1.AutoWithdrawCadence
types.doc:
AutoWithdrawCadence is how often an auto-withdraw rule runs. Every slot
 is a UTC time, with no daylight-saving shift.

values.name: DAILY
values.doc: Once a day at minute_of_day UTC.

values.name: WEEKLY
values.doc: Once a week on weekday at minute_of_day UTC.

values.name: HOURLY
values.doc:
Checked every hour at minute_of_hour UTC; pays only an asset whose
 payable amount has reached its minimums, so a payout follows within the
 hour of the balance reaching them. An hour with nothing to pay records
 no run.

values.name: BIWEEKLY
values.doc:
Every two weeks on weekday at minute_of_day UTC: in the week of
 anchor_date and every second week before or after it.

values.name: MONTHLY
values.doc:
Once a month on day_of_month at minute_of_day UTC. A month without that
 day runs on its last day: day 31 runs on April 30 and on February 28 or
 29, and days 29 and 30 run on the last day of February.

types.name: chain.withdraw.v1.AutoWithdrawDestination
types.doc:
AutoWithdrawDestination pays one asset, in kind, to one external-chain
 address.

fields.name: asset_id
fields.doc: Ledger asset paid. At most one destination per asset.

fields.name: destination_chain_id
fields.doc: External destination chain identifier.

fields.name: destination_address
fields.doc:
Destination address on destination_chain_id. It must be on the
 account's external withdraw whitelist when the rule is written and
 whenever a run pays it. Responses carry its canonical form.

fields.name: min_amount_e18
fields.doc:
A run pays this asset only when the payable amount reaches this
 minimum, in 18-decimal asset units, and the rule's min_usd_value_e18;
 otherwise the balance stays on the account for a later run. Must be at
 least min_floor_e18 when the rule is set.

fields.name: max_amount_e18
fields.doc:
The most one run pays this asset, in 18-decimal asset units; at least
 min_amount_e18. A larger balance pays this ceiling and the rest stays on
 the account.

fields.name: min_floor_e18
fields.doc:
Returned in responses only; ignored in requests. The least amount one
 payout to this destination can pay now, in 18-decimal asset units: the
 route's withdrawal minimum, and more than its current network fee. It
 follows the network fee, so it can change between reads. A run pays at
 least this floor and min_amount_e18, and a new rule needs a
 min_amount_e18 of at least the floor. Unset when the route or its network
 fee is not known now; a new rule for that destination is then refused
 with FEE_UNAVAILABLE or a route code.

types.name: chain.withdraw.v1.AutoWithdrawPause
types.doc: AutoWithdrawPause reports why a rule stopped running on its own.

fields.name: asset_id
fields.doc: Asset whose payout paused the rule; zero when no payout did.

fields.name: reason
fields.doc:
Machine-readable reason: destination_not_whitelisted when the
 destination left the account's external withdraw whitelist,
 destination_invalid when it is no longer a valid destination, or
 authority_revoked when the person who set the rule may no longer change
 it or withdraw from the account. On a broker vault the rule pauses with
 authority_revoked as soon as its author's broker role changes in any
 way: removed, demoted, or promoted (for example Finance to Owner), and
 also when the author is removed and added back. An Owner or Finance
 member resumes it with a fresh step-up.

fields.name: paused_at
fields.doc: When the rule was paused.

types.name: chain.withdraw.v1.AutoWithdrawPreviewAsset
types.doc:
AutoWithdrawPreviewAsset is what the next run would do with one asset,
 sized from the account's balance now.

fields.name: asset_id
fields.doc: Ledger asset.

fields.name: destination_chain_id
fields.doc:
External destination chain identifier; zero when the rule has no
 destination for the asset.

fields.name: destination_address
fields.doc:
Canonical destination address; empty when the rule has no destination
 for the asset.

fields.name: available_e18
fields.doc:
The account's available balance of the asset now, in 18-decimal asset
 units.

fields.name: payable_e18
fields.doc:
What the run would pay, in 18-decimal asset units: the available balance
 up to max_amount_e18, rounded down to whole on-chain units, or zero when
 it holds. The network fee is taken out of it on the way.

fields.name: held_back_e18
fields.doc:
What would stay on the account, in 18-decimal asset units:
 available_e18 minus payable_e18.

fields.name: hold_reason
fields.doc:
Why held_back_e18 stays, or why nothing pays: below_minimum (below
 minimum_e18 or the rule's min_usd_value_e18), price_unavailable (the
 rule has a USD minimum and no current price values the asset),
 no_destination (the rule pays no destination for the asset),
 destination_cooling_down (a broker vault pays a destination only once
 it has been on the vault's external withdraw whitelist for 24 hours;
 see payable_from), above_max (the balance above max_amount_e18 stays)
 or dust (less than one whole on-chain unit stays); empty when the whole
 balance pays.

fields.name: minimum_e18
fields.doc:
The least one payout of the asset pays, in 18-decimal asset units: the
 destination's min_amount_e18, or its min_floor_e18 when that is higher
 and known now. Unset when the rule has no destination for the asset.

fields.name: value_usd_e18
fields.doc:
USD value, in 18-decimal USD units, of what the asset pays before its
 minimums (the available balance up to max_amount_e18, rounded down to
 whole on-chain units), at the current price as of priced_at. A rule with
 a USD minimum compares this value with it. Unset when no current price
 values the asset or the rule has no destination for it.

fields.name: priced_at
fields.doc: When the price behind value_usd_e18 was observed; unset with it.

fields.name: network_fee_e18
fields.doc:
The network fee a payout to the destination is expected to be charged
 now, in 18-decimal asset units: the route's latest sampled network fee,
 the same figure min_floor_e18 stays above. It is taken out of the
 payout, so the destination receives about payable_e18 minus this fee.
 Unset when the rule has no destination for the asset or the fee is not
 known now.

fields.name: network_fee_sampled_at
fields.doc: When network_fee_e18 was sampled; unset with it.

fields.name: payable_from
fields.doc:
Set only on a broker vault while the destination is cooling down: when
 it can be paid, 24 hours after it was added to the vault's external
 withdraw whitelist. Unset with hold_reason destination_cooling_down
 when that time is not known yet.

types.name: chain.withdraw.v1.AutoWithdrawPreviewStatus
types.doc:
AutoWithdrawPreviewStatus is whether the next run would pay, judged from
 the account's balances now.

values.name: WILL_PAY
values.doc: At least one asset would pay.

values.name: ROLLS_OVER
values.doc:
Nothing would pay: every asset with a destination is below its minimum
 or the rule's USD minimum, has no current price for that minimum, or
 pays a broker vault's destination that is still cooling down. The
 balance stays on the account for a later run.

values.name: NO_DESTINATION
values.doc:
Nothing would pay, and every positive balance is in an asset the rule
 has no destination for.

values.name: PAUSED
values.doc:
The rule is paused, by a person or by itself (see pause); no run starts
 until it is resumed.

values.name: NO_RULE
values.doc: The account has no rule.

types.name: chain.withdraw.v1.AutoWithdrawRule
types.doc:
AutoWithdrawRule is one version of an account's auto-withdraw rule. Each
 change, pause or resume creates the next version; only the latest version
 runs, and a run in progress keeps the version it started with but pays
 nothing further once that version is no longer the latest.

fields.name: subaccount_id
fields.doc:
Public subaccount ID the rule belongs to; zero for the root account.

Public ID. ConnectRPC carries it as fixed64 (a decimal string in JSON).

fields.name: version
fields.doc: Rule version, starting at 1.

fields.name: enabled
fields.doc:
Whether the rule runs. A paused version (enabled false) keeps its
 schedule and destinations, so it resumes to the same destinations. The
 rule runs only while enabled and without a pause.

fields.name: schedule
fields.doc: When the rule runs.

fields.name: destinations
fields.doc:
One destination per paid asset, ordered by asset_id. Empty only on a
 version that was disabled before pausing kept destinations.

fields.name: created_at
fields.doc: When this version was created.

fields.name: pause
fields.doc:
Set when the rule paused itself; resuming it or setting a new rule
 clears it.

fields.name: min_usd_value_e18
fields.doc:
Least USD value one payout of the rule pays, in 18-decimal USD units;
 zero means no USD minimum.

fields.name: created_by_account_id
fields.doc: Public account ID of the person who created this version.

types.name: chain.withdraw.v1.AutoWithdrawRun
types.doc: AutoWithdrawRun is one scheduled run of an account's rule.

fields.name: run_seq
fields.doc: The account's run number, increasing by one per run.

fields.name: rule_version
fields.doc: The rule version the run executes.

fields.name: scheduled_for
fields.doc: The scheduled slot the run belongs to.

fields.name: state
fields.doc: Where the run stands.

fields.name: reason
fields.doc:
Machine-readable reason for a skipped run: nothing_to_pay,
 price_unavailable (an asset was not paid because no current price valued
 it) or rule_superseded; empty otherwise.

fields.name: steps
fields.doc:
One step per destination of the rule version, ordered by asset_id.
 Empty while the run is planned.

fields.name: created_at
fields.doc: When the run started.

fields.name: finished_at
fields.doc: When the run ended; unset while it is in progress.

types.name: chain.withdraw.v1.AutoWithdrawRunState
types.doc: AutoWithdrawRunState is where one auto-withdraw run stands.

values.name: RUN_PLANNED
values.doc: The run is reading the account's balances.

values.name: RUN_PAYING
values.doc: The run's payouts are in progress.

values.name: RUN_COMPLETED
values.doc: Every payout completed or was skipped, and at least one paid.

values.name: RUN_PARTIALLY_FAILED
values.doc:
Some payouts failed. Each failed step says where its funds are
 (STEP_FAILED).

values.name: RUN_FAILED
values.doc:
Every attempted payout failed. Each failed step says where its funds are
 (STEP_FAILED).

values.name: RUN_SKIPPED
values.doc:
Nothing was paid: every asset was below its minimum, no current price
 valued it, or the rule was no longer current.

types.name: chain.withdraw.v1.AutoWithdrawSchedule
types.doc:
AutoWithdrawSchedule is a rule's UTC run slot. Only the fields of its
 cadence may be set; the others must be zero or empty.

fields.name: cadence
fields.doc: How often the rule runs.

fields.name: weekday
fields.doc: Run day of a weekly or biweekly rule.

fields.name: minute_of_day
fields.doc:
Minute after 00:00 UTC the run starts, 0 to 1439, for every cadence but
 HOURLY; must be 0 for an hourly rule.

fields.name: minute_of_hour
fields.doc: Minute past every hour an HOURLY rule is checked, 0 to 59.

fields.name: day_of_month
fields.doc: Run day of a MONTHLY rule, 1 to 31; see MONTHLY for shorter months.

fields.name: anchor_date
fields.doc:
A UTC date (YYYY-MM-DD) in a week a BIWEEKLY rule runs; weeks start on
 Monday. Responses return the Monday that starts that week.

types.name: chain.withdraw.v1.AutoWithdrawStep
types.doc: AutoWithdrawStep is one asset's payout in a run.

fields.name: asset_id
fields.doc: Ledger asset paid.

fields.name: destination_chain_id
fields.doc: External destination chain identifier.

fields.name: destination_address
fields.doc: Canonical destination address.

fields.name: available_e18
fields.doc:
The account's available balance of the asset when the run started, in
 18-decimal asset units.

fields.name: amount_e18
fields.doc:
What the step pays, in 18-decimal asset units: the available balance
 up to the ceiling, rounded down to whole on-chain units. Zero when
 skipped. The remainder stays on the account.

fields.name: state
fields.doc: Where the payout stands.

fields.name: reason
fields.doc:
Machine-readable reason for a skipped or failed step, such as
 below_minimum, price_unavailable (the rule has a USD minimum and no
 current price valued the asset; the funds stay for a later run),
 rule_superseded, destination_not_whitelisted, destination_cooling_down
 (a broker vault's destination added to its external withdraw whitelist
 less than 24 hours ago; the funds stay for a later run),
 authority_revoked, gateway_capacity_insufficient (the funds stay for a
 later run), withdrawal_released or withdrawal_failed; empty otherwise.

fields.name: intent_id
fields.doc:
Withdraw intent identifier once the withdrawal is accepted; follows the
 same lifecycle as a user withdrawal.

fields.name: tx_hash
fields.doc: Destination-network transaction hash once the withdrawal completed.

fields.name: value_usd_e18
fields.doc:
USD value of the payable amount when the run started, in 18-decimal USD
 units, checked against the rule's min_usd_value_e18. Unset when the rule
 has no USD minimum or no current price was available.

fields.name: network_fee_e18
fields.doc:
The network fee charged on the withdrawal, in 18-decimal asset units.
 Once it completed: taken out of amount_e18, so the destination received
 amount_e18 minus this fee. Once Zipper rejected it or its execution
 failed: the fee Zipper kept, which is not refunded. Unset until the step
 is final, when it was skipped or failed before it reached Zipper, and
 when the fee was not reported.

types.name: chain.withdraw.v1.AutoWithdrawStepState
types.doc: AutoWithdrawStepState is where one asset's payout of a run stands.

values.name: STEP_PENDING
values.doc: Planned; not yet requested.

values.name: STEP_SUBMITTING
values.doc: Being requested.

values.name: STEP_SUBMITTED
values.doc: Withdrawal accepted; waiting for it to complete on chain.

values.name: STEP_COMPLETED
values.doc: The withdrawal completed on chain.

values.name: STEP_FAILED
values.doc:
The withdrawal failed. Where its funds are depends on when it failed,
 which its withdrawal flow shows:
 - before it left the account: they stay on the account;
 - rejected by Zipper (flow REFUNDED, reason ZIPPER_VALIDATION_REJECTED or
   ZIPPER_EXECUTION_REJECTED): amount_e18 less network_fee_e18 is
   refunded, as zTokens, to the account's smart account wallet, not to
   the account's balance, and the network fee is not refunded;
 - its execution failed after its destination transaction was sent (flow
   FAILED, reason ZIPPER_WITHDRAW_EXECUTION_FAILED): Zipper reviews it and
   settles it outside Polyester Chain; nothing is returned to the account.

values.name: STEP_SKIPPED
values.doc: Nothing was paid for this asset in this run.

types.name: chain.withdraw.v1.AutoWithdrawWeekday
types.doc: AutoWithdrawWeekday is the run day of a weekly or biweekly rule.

values.name: MONDAY
values.doc: Monday.

values.name: TUESDAY
values.doc: Tuesday.

values.name: WEDNESDAY
values.doc: Wednesday.

values.name: THURSDAY
values.doc: Thursday.

values.name: FRIDAY
values.doc: Friday.

values.name: SATURDAY
values.doc: Saturday.

values.name: SUNDAY
values.doc: Sunday.

types.name: chain.withdraw.v1.CreateTradingWithdrawRequest
types.doc:
CreateTradingWithdrawRequest creates or returns one durable backend-authorized
 Trading withdraw intent from typed protobuf fields and an API-key signature.

fields.name: payload
fields.doc: Client-signed withdraw details.

fields.name: payload_signature
fields.doc:
User/API signature over deterministic TradingWithdrawIntentPayload bytes.
 Must not be empty.

types.name: chain.withdraw.v1.CreateTradingWithdrawResponse
types.doc:
CreateTradingWithdrawResponse returns the accepted durable intent identifier
 for the withdraw lifecycle.

fields.name: intent_id
fields.doc:
Stable server-owned intent identifier for the accepted withdraw lifecycle.
 Clients use this id to follow later progress for the same withdraw flow.

types.name: chain.withdraw.v1.CreateWalletTradingWithdrawRequest
types.doc:
CreateWalletTradingWithdrawRequest creates or returns one durable Trading
 withdraw intent from typed frontend fields plus a wallet personal_sign signature.

fields.name: payload
fields.doc: Client-signed withdraw details.

fields.name: subaccount_id
fields.doc:
Optional public subaccount id. Omit to withdraw from the JWT root account.

Public ID. ConnectRPC carries it as uint64 (a decimal string in JSON).

fields.name: signer_wallet
fields.doc: Wallet address that produced payload_signature.

fields.name: payload_signature
fields.doc:
Wallet EIP-191 personal_sign signature over the canonical withdraw
 authorization message. Must not be empty.

types.name: chain.withdraw.v1.CreateWalletTradingWithdrawResponse
types.doc:
CreateWalletTradingWithdrawResponse returns the accepted durable intent
 identifier for a wallet-authorized withdraw lifecycle.

fields.name: intent_id
fields.doc:
Stable server-owned intent identifier for the accepted withdraw lifecycle.
 Clients use this id to follow later progress for the same withdraw flow.

types.name: chain.withdraw.v1.ErrorCode
types.doc:
ErrorCode identifies stable, machine-readable Withdraw API errors.
 Values mirror the REST problem+json code field.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS
values.doc: The source account does not have enough available Trading balance.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_INVALID_REQUEST
values.doc: Request payload or one of its fields is invalid.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_UNAUTHENTICATED
values.doc: Caller is not authenticated.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_PERMISSION_DENIED
values.doc: Caller is not permitted to perform the withdraw operation.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED
values.doc: Request exceeded the applicable admission rate limit.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE
values.doc: A required dependency is temporarily unavailable.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_INTERNAL_ERROR
values.doc: The request failed because of an unexpected server error.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_INVALID_SUBACCOUNT_ID
values.doc: The selected subaccount identifier is invalid.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_SUBACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND
values.doc: The selected subaccount does not exist.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_INVALID_ACTION
values.doc: The requested withdraw action is invalid for this endpoint.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_UNSUPPORTED_LEDGER
values.doc: The requested ledger is not supported for withdrawals.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_UNSUPPORTED_ASSET
values.doc: The requested asset or withdraw route is not supported.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_INVALID_AMOUNT
values.doc: The withdraw amount is invalid.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_INVALID_DESTINATION_CHAIN
values.doc: The destination chain is invalid.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_INVALID_DESTINATION_ADDRESS
values.doc: The destination address is invalid.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_EXTERNAL_DESTINATION_NOT_WHITELISTED
values.doc: The external destination is not whitelisted.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_INTERNAL_RECIPIENT_NOT_WHITELISTED
values.doc: The internal funding recipient is not whitelisted.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_AMOUNT_BELOW_MINIMUM
values.doc: The withdraw amount is below the configured minimum including fees.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_AMOUNT_EXCEEDS_SUPPLY
values.doc: The withdraw amount exceeds the available zipped-asset supply.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_SOURCE_SMART_ACCOUNT_UNAVAILABLE
values.doc: The source smart-account address is unavailable.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_SIGNATURE_REQUIRED
values.doc: The required payload signature is missing.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_SIGNATURE_SCHEME_UNSUPPORTED
values.doc: The requested signature scheme is unsupported.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_SIGNER_WALLET_INVALID
values.doc: The wallet supplied as signer is invalid.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_WALLET_BINDING_INVALID
values.doc: Wallet authorization binding verification failed.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_WALLET_BINDING_SCOPE_MISMATCH
values.doc: Wallet authorization binding does not cover the requested scope.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_WALLET_BINDING_SIGNER_MISMATCH
values.doc: Wallet authorization binding does not match the signer.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_API_KEY_NOT_FOUND
values.doc: The API key could not be resolved.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_API_KEY_BINDING_INVALID
values.doc: API-key authorization binding verification failed.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_API_KEY_BINDING_SCOPE_MISMATCH
values.doc: API-key authorization binding does not cover the requested scope.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_API_KEY_BINDING_PUBLIC_KEY_MISMATCH
values.doc: API-key authorization binding does not match the configured public key.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT
values.doc: The idempotency key was reused with different request data.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_FUNDS_LOCK_CONFLICT
values.doc: The funds lock conflicts with an existing or finalized reservation.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_CAPITAL_VIEW_UNAVAILABLE
values.doc: The authoritative capital view is not ready or is stale.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_CHAIN_METADATA_UNAVAILABLE
values.doc: Required chain or contract metadata is unavailable.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_FEE_UNAVAILABLE
values.doc: Required network fee data is unavailable.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_SUPPLY_UNAVAILABLE
values.doc: Required zipped-asset supply data is unavailable.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_STEP_UP_UNAVAILABLE
values.doc: Fresh step-up verification is temporarily unavailable.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_DESTINATION_VALIDATION_UNAVAILABLE
values.doc: Destination validation is temporarily unavailable.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_ACCOUNT_SHARD_UNAVAILABLE
values.doc: Funds movement for this account is temporarily unavailable. Retry later.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_FAILED_PRECONDITION
values.doc: A required precondition was not satisfied.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_NOT_FOUND
values.doc: The requested resource was not found.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_CONFLICT
values.doc: The request conflicts with existing state.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_INVALID_AUTO_WITHDRAW_SCHEDULE
values.doc:
The auto-withdraw schedule is invalid: a field its cadence needs is
 missing or out of range, or a field of another cadence is set.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_AMOUNT_EXCEEDS_ROUTE_PRECISION
values.doc:
The withdraw amount has more decimal places than the destination
 network's token supports (AssetChainVariant.source_decimals). Round
 amount_e18 down to a whole number of that token's smallest units before
 signing.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_DESTINATION_INVALID
values.doc:
An auto-withdraw destination address is not a valid withdrawal
 destination on its chain. ErrorDetail.field_path names the destination.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_MIN_AMOUNT_BELOW_FLOOR
values.doc:
An auto-withdraw destination's min_amount_e18 is below the least amount
 a payout to it can pay. ErrorDetail.min_floor_e18 is that floor and
 ErrorDetail.field_path names the field.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_ROUTE_UNSUPPORTED
values.doc:
No enabled withdrawal route pays an auto-withdraw destination's asset to
 its destination chain. ErrorDetail.field_path names the field.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_VERSION_CONFLICT
values.doc:
expected_version is not the auto-withdraw rule's latest version: another
 change landed first. Read the rule again before retrying.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_EXTERNAL_DESTINATION_COOLING_DOWN
values.doc:
A broker vault pays an external destination only once it has been on the
 vault's external withdraw whitelist for 24 hours, and this one was added
 more recently. ErrorDetail.payable_from is when it can be paid; unset
 when that time is not known yet. Retry after it.

types.name: chain.withdraw.v1.ErrorDetail
types.doc: ErrorDetail is attached to ConnectRPC errors for structured error handling.

fields.name: code
fields.doc: Stable error code matching the REST problem+json code field.

fields.name: field_path
fields.doc:
Field the error is about, as a protobuf field path such as
 destinations[0].min_amount_e18; empty when the error concerns no single
 field. Usually a field of the request. A refused auto-withdraw resume
 names a field of the stored rule instead, such as
 destinations[1].destination_address of AutoWithdrawRule, which the
 request does not carry.

fields.name: min_floor_e18
fields.doc:
Set only with MIN_AMOUNT_BELOW_FLOOR: the least amount, in 18-decimal
 asset units, the destination's min_amount_e18 may be.

fields.name: payable_from
fields.doc:
Set only with EXTERNAL_DESTINATION_COOLING_DOWN, when known: the time
 from which the destination can be paid.

types.name: chain.withdraw.v1.GetAutoWithdrawRuleRequest
types.doc: GetAutoWithdrawRuleRequest reads the latest rule version.

fields.name: subaccount_id
fields.doc:
Public subaccount ID; omit for the root account.

Public ID. ConnectRPC carries it as fixed64 (a decimal string in JSON).

types.name: chain.withdraw.v1.GetAutoWithdrawRuleResponse
types.doc: GetAutoWithdrawRuleResponse returns the latest rule version.

fields.name: rule
fields.doc: The latest version; unset when the account never had a rule.

types.name: chain.withdraw.v1.GetWalletBalancesRequest
types.doc:
GetWalletBalancesRequest selects the account whose smart account wallet
 to read.

fields.name: subaccount_id
fields.doc:
Public subaccount ID; omit for the root account.

Public ID. ConnectRPC carries it as fixed64 (a decimal string in JSON).

types.name: chain.withdraw.v1.GetWalletBalancesResponse
types.doc:
GetWalletBalancesResponse is the smart account wallet's zToken balances,
 read from Polyester Chain at its latest block.

fields.name: smart_account_address
fields.doc: Smart account wallet whose balances these are.

fields.name: balances
fields.doc:
Every zToken the wallet holds a nonzero balance of, ordered by
 zipped_asset_id. Empty when it holds none.

types.name: chain.withdraw.v1.ListAutoWithdrawRunsRequest
types.doc: ListAutoWithdrawRunsRequest pages through an account's runs, newest first.

fields.name: subaccount_id
fields.doc:
Public subaccount ID; omit for the root account.

Public ID. ConnectRPC carries it as fixed64 (a decimal string in JSON).

fields.name: limit
fields.doc: Maximum number of runs to return: 0 means 20, at most 100.

fields.name: page_token
fields.doc:
Opaque, exclusive, keyset-backed cursor from a previous response,
 bound to the caller's account or subaccount and the newest-first
 run_seq order. Empty for the first page.

types.name: chain.withdraw.v1.ListAutoWithdrawRunsResponse
types.doc: ListAutoWithdrawRunsResponse returns one page of runs, newest first.

fields.name: runs
fields.doc: Runs ordered by run_seq, newest first.

fields.name: next_page_token
fields.doc: Cursor for the next page. Empty when no more results exist.

types.name: chain.withdraw.v1.PreviewAutoWithdrawRunRequest
types.doc:
PreviewAutoWithdrawRunRequest previews the next run of the rule of the
 root account or one subaccount.

fields.name: subaccount_id
fields.doc:
Public subaccount ID; omit for the root account.

Public ID. ConnectRPC carries it as fixed64 (a decimal string in JSON).

types.name: chain.withdraw.v1.PreviewAutoWithdrawRunResponse
types.doc: PreviewAutoWithdrawRunResponse previews the next run.

fields.name: status
fields.doc: Whether the next run would pay.

fields.name: next_run_at
fields.doc:
When the next run starts: its UTC slot, or, while a due slot waits for
 the scheduler, that slot. For an hourly rule, the next hourly check.
 Unset when the account has no rule or the rule is paused.

fields.name: rule_version
fields.doc: The latest rule version; zero when the account has no rule.

fields.name: pause
fields.doc: Set when the rule paused itself; a rule paused by a person has none.

fields.name: min_usd_value_e18
fields.doc:
The rule's least USD value of one payout, in 18-decimal USD units; zero
 means no USD minimum. Unset when the account has no rule.

fields.name: assets
fields.doc:
One entry per destination of the rule, then per other asset with a
 positive balance, ordered by asset_id. Empty when the account has no
 rule or the rule is paused.

fields.name: computed_at
fields.doc: When the balances, prices and fees the preview used were read.

types.name: chain.withdraw.v1.SetAutoWithdrawRuleEnabledRequest
types.doc:
SetAutoWithdrawRuleEnabledRequest pauses or resumes the rule of the root
 account or one subaccount, keeping its schedule and destinations.

fields.name: subaccount_id
fields.doc:
Public subaccount ID; omit for the root account.

Public ID. ConnectRPC carries it as fixed64 (a decimal string in JSON).

fields.name: expected_version
fields.doc:
The account's latest rule version. A mismatch is rejected so concurrent
 changes never overwrite each other.

fields.name: enabled
fields.doc: false pauses the rule; true resumes it.

types.name: chain.withdraw.v1.SetAutoWithdrawRuleEnabledResponse
types.doc: SetAutoWithdrawRuleEnabledResponse returns the rule's latest version.

fields.name: rule
fields.doc:
The created version, or the latest version unchanged when the rule was
 already in the requested state.

types.name: chain.withdraw.v1.SetAutoWithdrawRuleRequest
types.doc:
SetAutoWithdrawRuleRequest creates or replaces the rule of the root
 account or one subaccount.

fields.name: subaccount_id
fields.doc:
Public subaccount ID; omit for the root account.

Public ID. ConnectRPC carries it as fixed64 (a decimal string in JSON).

fields.name: expected_version
fields.doc:
The version the change replaces: 0 when the account has no rule yet,
 otherwise its latest version. A mismatch is rejected so concurrent
 changes never overwrite each other.

fields.name: schedule
fields.doc: When the rule runs.

fields.name: destinations
fields.doc: Destinations, one per asset, 1 to 32.

fields.name: min_usd_value_e18
fields.doc:
Least USD value one payout pays, in 18-decimal USD units; unset or zero
 for no USD minimum. Each run values each asset's payable amount at the
 current index price. A smaller amount stays on the account for a later
 run, and the asset is skipped with reason price_unavailable when no
 current price is available. A payout never goes below its destination's
 min_amount_e18 or the route's withdrawal minimum.

types.name: chain.withdraw.v1.SetAutoWithdrawRuleResponse
types.doc: SetAutoWithdrawRuleResponse returns the new rule version.

fields.name: rule
fields.doc: The created version.

types.name: chain.withdraw.v1.TradingWithdrawAction
types.doc: TradingWithdrawAction identifies where funds should move from Trading.

types.name: chain.withdraw.v1.TradingWithdrawIntentPayload
types.doc:
TradingWithdrawIntentPayload is the client-signed typed withdraw request.
 Account scope and backend intent ids are derived server-side.

fields.name: action
fields.doc: Destination for funds leaving Trading.

fields.name: asset_id
fields.doc:
Unified asset identifier from Polyester asset metadata. amount_e18 is
 denominated in this asset at canonical 18-decimal scale.

fields.name: destination_chain_id
fields.doc: External network id for TO_EXTERNAL_CHAIN. Omit for TO_FUNDING.

fields.name: amount_e18
fields.doc:
Withdraw amount in canonical 18-decimal unified asset units.
 For example, 0.5 is encoded as 500000000000000000. For TO_EXTERNAL_CHAIN,
 it must be a whole number of the destination network token's smallest
 units: a multiple of 10^(18 - AssetChainVariant.source_decimals) when the
 token has fewer than 18 decimals. A finer amount is refused with
 ERROR_CODE_AMOUNT_EXCEEDS_ROUTE_PRECISION before any funds are reserved.

fields.name: deadline_ts_sec
fields.doc:
Unix timestamp in seconds after which this signed user authorization is no
 longer accepted by the API. This is separate from the server-owned
 execution deadline used later for on-chain submission.

fields.name: nonce
fields.doc:
Client-generated unsigned 128-bit nonce bound to the signed request. This
 is an identifier, not a decimal amount.

fields.name: destination_address
fields.doc:
Destination address. For TO_EXTERNAL_CHAIN this is an address on
 destination_chain_id and is validated according to that network. For
 TO_FUNDING, omit it to move funds to the selected account's Funding account
 or provide another Polyester funding address for a Trading-to-Funding
 transfer.

fields.name: idempotency_key
fields.doc:
Client-chosen idempotency key. Reusing the same key with the same payload
 returns the existing withdraw; reusing it with different payload fails.

types.name: chain.withdraw.v1.ValidateWithdrawDestinationRequest
types.doc:
ValidateWithdrawDestinationRequest checks one external-chain
 destination for an authenticated caller without creating a withdraw.

fields.name: destination_chain_id
fields.doc: External destination chain identifier.

fields.name: destination_address
fields.doc: Destination address to validate for destination_chain_id.

types.name: chain.withdraw.v1.ValidateWithdrawDestinationResponse
types.doc:
ValidateWithdrawDestinationResponse returns a user-safe validation
 result without exposing internal denylist details.

fields.name: valid
fields.doc: Whether the destination may be used for a withdraw.

fields.name: code
fields.doc: Public validation outcome code.

fields.name: message
fields.doc: User-safe explanation of the validation outcome.

fields.name: canonical_destination_address
fields.doc: Canonical destination address when valid. Empty when valid is false.

types.name: chain.withdraw.v1.WalletBalance
types.doc: WalletBalance is one zToken the smart account wallet holds.

fields.name: zipped_asset_id
fields.doc:
Zipped asset of the zToken: the network-specific asset, as
 chain.lifecycle.v1.AssetIds.zipped_asset_id names it.

fields.name: unified_asset_id
fields.doc:
Unified asset the zToken stands for, as
 chain.lifecycle.v1.AssetIds.unified_asset_id names it.

fields.name: chain_id
fields.doc:
External network of the zipped asset, as the `chain_id` of a chain
 returned by `GetDepositWithdrawConfig`.

fields.name: ztoken_address
fields.doc: zToken contract address on Polyester Chain.

fields.name: amount_e18
fields.doc: Balance in 18-decimal units: every zToken has 18 decimals.

types.name: chain.withdraw.v1.WithdrawDestinationValidationCode
types.doc:
WithdrawDestinationValidationCode identifies the public outcome of an
 external-chain destination validation.

values.name: VALID
values.doc: The destination is valid and may be used for a withdraw.

values.name: INVALID_ADDRESS
values.doc: The address is not valid for the selected destination chain.

values.name: UNSUPPORTED_CHAIN
values.doc: The selected destination chain is not supported for withdraws.

values.name: POLYESTER_SMART_ACCOUNT
values.doc:
The destination is a Polyester smart account and cannot be used for an
 external-chain withdraw.

values.name: TOKEN_CONTRACT
values.doc: The destination is a token contract and cannot receive withdrawals.

values.name: DENYLISTED_ADDRESS
values.doc: The destination is blocked by Polyester's user-safety denylist.
